assumptions: Candidate valve discs and stems are packing envelopes, without seat cone, tulip, fillet or fatigue definition.
34/29 diameters, 36 mm pair pitch, +/-17 mm rows, 4 mm disc datum and 80 mm stem length are new unmeasured design assumptions.
Inherited meshes retain their native coordinates under the unverified 1 unit/mm assumption.
Positive bank slider-crank is screened; other bank timing and all cam laws remain undefined.
Lift and crank angle combinations are diagnostic poses, not a prescribed cam or operating cycle.
Zero mesh intersection is not positive clearance or physical acceptance; native grids are not manufacturing tolerances.
